The supplied structural facts report no separator-derived region rows and one implicit UML region under CA, despite direct children named CA.Frontend, CA.RearEnd, and CA.Pedestrian. decisions.basis: Pair 0057 V4 dossier with exact binding to state:UnspecifiedInitial:line:29, finite reachability, zero outgoing transitions, formal predicate semantics, and completed backend receipt.

No exact terminal clause, formal terminal edge to [*], or explicit terminal fact is supplied, so an intentional-terminal interpretation is not competent. A transition owned elsewhere also cannot provide continuation for this exact leaf.
